contact.name: Patrick Schafer
contact.evidence_quote: “We pride ourselves on providing unmatched support and service to our customers and we are honored to be recognized by United Cargo,” said Patrick Schafer, CSafe CEO. “I want to thank United Cargo and Jan Krems for this award. And a special note of thanks goes to our own Jez Palmer, senior director of partner alliance (airlines) for CSafe, for his ongoing dedication to building and maintaining strong relationships with our airline partners.”
